<!-- generated by packaging/cli_reference.py from `netpulse report --help`; do not edit -->

```text
netpulse report [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--since <SINCE>` | Period: 24h, 7d or all [default: 24h] |
| `--format <FORMAT>` | md or json [default: md] |
| `-o, --out <OUT>` | Output file (default: the reports folder) |

Also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options) `--config <FILE>` and `--json`.
